_meta.what: Representative out-of-warranty repair for each NHTSA complaint component group.
_meta.method: cost = flat_rate_hours x labour_rate + parts. hours are typical published flat-rate times for the representative job on a mainstream passenger car; parts is a low-high band for a quality aftermarket or OE part. Labour rate is the US independent-shop reference below; every figure is re-priced to the visitor's country by the parts-and-labour index in geo_prices.json.
_meta.note: These are typical costs for the representative job in the group, not a quote for a specific car, and not a claim that this repair will be needed.

ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING.job: Water pump, thermostat and coolant service

ELECTRICAL SYSTEM.job: Alternator, battery-drain or body-module diagnosis and replacement

SERVICE BRAKES.job: Pads, rotors and caliper service, both axles

HYDRAULIC.job: Brake master cylinder or ABS module replacement

STEERING.job: Electric power-steering rack or column motor replacement

SUSPENSION.job: Struts, springs and control-arm bushings, one axle

AIR BAGS.job: Airbag module, clockspring or sensor replacement

VISIBILITY/WIPER.job: Wiper motor, linkage or windscreen replacement

FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE.job: Radar or camera module replacement and calibration

VEHICLE SPEED CONTROL.job: Throttle body, pedal sensor or cruise module replacement

ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL (ESC).job: Yaw sensor or ESC module replacement

SEATS.job: Seat frame, track or occupancy-sensor repair

LATCHES/LOCKS/LINKAGES.job: Door latch or lock actuator replacement

TIRES.job: Tyre replacement and TPMS service, per axle

HYBRID PROPULSION SYSTEM.job: Hybrid battery module or inverter service

ELECTRIC PROPULSION SYSTEM.job: Drive unit, charger or HV cable service
